Balaji Amines Limited is a prominent chemical manufacturing company headquartered at 165-A Railway Lines, Solapur - 413001, Maharashtra, India. Established as a leading player in the specialty chemicals industry, the company has carved a strong niche in producing a wide range of amines, which serve as critical intermediates for various industrial applications. With its strategic location in Solapur, a well-connected industrial hub, Balaji Amines leverages robust infrastructure and logistic advantages to efficiently cater to both domestic and international markets.

The company’s product portfolio encompasses a diverse range of aliphatic and aromatic amines, including methylamines, ethylamines, and their derivatives, which are integral in manufacturing pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, water treatment agents, rubber chemicals, and various specialty chemicals. By focusing on quality, innovation, and sustainable practices, Balaji Amines Limited ensures its products meet stringent industry standards and environmental regulations.

Balaji Amines is committed to continuous improvement and technological upgrading, which enables it to remain competitive in a rapidly evolving global chemical sector. The company’s emphasis on research and development, combined with a skilled workforce and advanced manufacturing facilities, supports its goal to deliver superior products and customized solutions to its diverse clientele.

Through its dedication to operational excellence, environmental stewardship, and customer satisfaction, Balaji Amines Limited continues to contribute significantly to the growth of the Indian chemical industry while also expanding its footprint globally.
